contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constatius II. AD355-361, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows Soldier advancing left, spearing fallen horseman. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(PT.).
